slice: RPP-5mr consumed MLINE append source counts 65 through 127
scope: Qualifies runtime-generated AC1027 one-element append profiles for every consumed MLINESTYLE source count 65 through 127, producing target counts 66 through 128. Evidence is specific to the selected tuple and consumer profile; it is not full format or document support.

contract.admission: For each count, a generated source style uses deterministic ordered offsets, ACI values and alternating ByLayer/Continuous linetypes; the transaction appends one tuple. Source and target flags are 2 with equal angles, and two source-bound open, uncut and unfilled MLINE consumers reference the style.
contract.geometry: The fixture computes source consumer parameters against the full source minimum. The append recalculates all parameters against the full target minimum. Source-consistent consumer geometry, positive finite scale, center/bottom justification, unit extrusion, directions, miters, per-element segment parameter pairs, absent group 42 and zero area-fill state are verified.
contract.identityAndOutput: Each style retains its source identity and emits exact group-71 count and ordered tuple fields. Unique ByLayer and Continuous LTYPE providers are checked. Both consumers retain group-340 style identity, emit group 73 equal to the target count, and pass exact group-74/group-41/group-75 output and fresh-import checks in model space and a named block.
contract.failureAndRetry: Unsupported flags and late live-consumer mutation each refuse before publication with destination and caller-state checks. Corrected state succeeds on the same adapter in ASCII and binary output.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. All source and output files are generated at runtime and removed after success; no DWG/DXF fixtures are committed.
contract.limits: New profiles are limited to one-element appends from counts 65 through 127 under the generated geometry, style and consumer recipe. Other append batches, removals, MLINE schema/carrier/version variants, native semantics and whole-document closure remain distinct. No support claim is promoted.

controls.failureAndRetry: Per count: four successful encoding combinations, eight readbacks, two unsupported-flag refusals, two late-mutation refusals and four corrected same-adapter retries.

focusedSelector.summary: The selector passed for all source counts 13 through 128: 464 successful source/output combinations, 928 readbacks, 232 unsupported-flag refusals, 232 late-mutation refusals and 464 corrected same-adapter retries.
